description: Send money to multiple recipients at once from your wallet balance. Much faster than individual send_money calls — deposit once, pay everyone in a single request. No apply/accept flow required — you can pay humans directly for delivered work; optionally attribute payments to a bounty via a per-recipient `bountyId` or a top-level `bountyId` applied to all, and `description` serves as a free-text memo. Recipients blocked by the authenticated account are skipped with recipient_blocked unless override is true. Requires sufficient wallet balance (use deposit_wallet first). Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

bountyId.description: a string at least 1 character(s) long
bountyId.title: minLength(1)

description.description: a string at most 500 character(s) long
description.title: maxLength(500)

recipients.description: an array of at most 100 item(s)

amount.description: a number less than or equal to 10000
amount.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10000)

bountyId.description: a string at least 1 character(s) long
bountyId.title: minLength(1)

conversationId.description: a string at least 1 character(s) long
conversationId.title: minLength(1)

description.description: a string at most 500 character(s) long
description.title: maxLength(500)

recipientId.description: a string at least 1 character(s) long
recipientId.title: minLength(1)

recipients.title: maxItems(100)

name: bulk_send_money
